decision_object: ETF pilot = 0.642 S3 + 0.358 C2 (plan v2 D7.1, normalized T-43 weights, no borrowing), fixed weights reset daily (same aggregation for every configuration); sleeve-level caps: each sleeve applies the rule to its own holdings on its own update days
execution_and_cost: signal at close d, effective at the open of d+1 (salvage legs); 10 bp per side on all traded notional, 2x check 20 bp; borrow 0 (Alpaca ETB, 2026-10-04 snapshot), 2x check 100 bp/yr on short notional; debit interest 6.5%/yr; short proceeds earn nothing
same_vol: k = sd(original)/sd(config) per window; same-vol excess = k (r - rf) - max(k-1,0)(0.065/252 - rf); judged on excess-over-BIL annualised Sharpe
sleeves: S3: tranche.s3_weights at offsets 0,4,8,12,16 (5-offset blend, judged) with the frozen vol target 0.40, dip boost 0.60 for 10 sessions; C2: screen_lane.weights_frame of C2 (h20260928_20_recent_opt, freq D, calendar-anchored, one version); cash SHY
theme_factor: on the 126 sessions W ending at the signal close d: beta = cov(r_SMH, r_SPY)/var(r_SPY), f_t = r_SMH,t - beta r_SPY,t (orthogonal to SPY on W); close-to-close SIP daily returns
theme_risk_share: p_t = sum_i w_i r_i,t on W at the sleeve's current risky weights (SHY, BIL = cash, zero risk); OLS p = a + b_m r_SPY + b_th f + e on W; TRS = b_th^2 var_W(f) / var_W(p) (Euler factor share, Roncalli-Weisang 2012 Th. 2); all-cash -> 0
version: substitution: on each sleeve update day, if TRS(w) > c move fraction s of every holding with b_th,i > 0 into its same-leverage substitute (TQQQ, SOXL, TECL -> UPRO; USD -> SSO; SMH, SOXX, XLK, QQQ, SPMO and any 1x holding -> SPY), s = smallest value on the grid 0, 0.01, ..., 1 with TRS(w(s)) <= c (s = 1 and flagged if none); the S3 vol scale is then computed on the capped book's own gross returns (frozen engine)

margin-account hedge: on each update day, given the sleeve's effective weights after its vol scale, overlay -h units of f (short h SMH, long h beta SPY) with h >= 0 solving TRS = c in closed form (h = 0 if TRS <= c); SPY leg funded from SHY first, rest is debit at 6.5%; if Alpaca margin rules fail (initial 50% of gross > equity, or maintenance 30% long, 50% 2x, 75% 3x, 30% short > 0.9 equity) h is cut to the largest feasible value

cash-account hedge: overlay n SOXS + u UPRO (n, u >= 0) whose W-loadings give -h on f and 0 on SPY (2x2 solve), h as in H1; funded only from the sleeve's cash (SHY/BIL); if n + u > cash, both scaled down to fit; actual SOXS and UPRO returns (daily reset decay and fees included)
windows: recent 2024-01-08..last archive session (decision); stress 2017-10-02..2023-08-31; full 2017-10-02..last session; replays R1 (SMH peak in 2024-06-01..07-31, trough by 08-31), R2 (peak 2025-01-01..03-31, trough by 04-30), R3 (peak 2026-06-01..07-31, trough by 08-31), dates frozen in build.json from SMH closes before evaluation
